title: Kusoma kwa Ufahamu (Theme 1: Nyumbani)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 4 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child reads the sentence around a new word and gives its meaning in Kiswahili, then uses it in a sentence of his own.

floor.prerequisite: Names rooms and things at home.
floor.question: Tunapikia wapi nyumbani?

representations: the passage with the target words in bold
a word card with its sentence
steps: Find the word in the passage.
Use it in your own sentence.

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child explains the word and writes a sentence with it.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Katika kifungu, neno "mche" lina maana gani?" Kwa nini "mchele" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Maneno yanaweza kufanana kwa umbo na yasiwe na maana sawa. Mche ni mmea mchanga wa kupanda, si mchele.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Katika kifungu, neno "kuchemsha" lina maana gani?" Kwa nini "kumimina uji vikombeni" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Jaribu kila maana mahali pa neno hilo. Maana sahihi ndiyo inayofaa sentensi nzima.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Katika kifungu, neno "madonge" lina maana gani?" Kwa nini "unga laini" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Maana ya neno hutegemea sentensi lilimotumika. Madonge ni vipande vilivyoshikana, si unga laini.

misconceptions.ask: Unaweza kueleza maana hiyo kwa Kiswahili?
misconceptions.repair: Eleza maana kwa Kiswahili: sebule ni chumba cha kukaa na wageni.

skills.key_step: The child answers only from the passage and gives the message of the whole story, not one detail.
representations: the story with its paragraphs numbered
steps: Find the paragraph with the answer.
Say the message of the whole story.

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child underlines the sentence that answers and says the message.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Nani alimwita Achieng sokoni?" Kwa nini "mama yake" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kifungu kinasema nani alifanya kitendo hicho. Soma sentensi hiyo tena.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Achieng alinunua nini sokoni?" Kwa nini "maziwa" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Jibu la swali la ufahamu liko kwenye kifungu. Tafuta sentensi inayolisema.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Mvua ilinyesha lini?" Kwa nini "asubuhi" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Maneno ya swali (nani, lini, wapi, nini) yanaonyesha jibu la aina gani. Soma kifungu tena.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ujumbe mkuu wa hadithi ni upi?" Kwa nini "Achieng alinunua nyanya." si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Ujumbe mkuu ni funzo la hadithi nzima, si jambo moja dogo ndani yake.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Matukio manne yamechanganywa. Yalitokea kwa mpangilio gani?" Kwa nini "D, C, B, A" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Hadithi inasimulia matukio kwa mpangilio. Maneno kama "kisha" na "baadaye" husaidia.

checks.question: Swali: Nani alipika? Jibu linatoka wapi?
Ujumbe ni jambo moja dogo au funzo la hadithi yote?
